document_contents.quote: alleging that no tax has been paid by the petitioner towards royalty, DMF, EMF, dead rent and surface rent, which constitute taxable supply, as the said aspects of supply are subject to tax under the reverse charge mechanism.

In the reply, categorical stand is taken that no taxable event had occurred during the relevant period as mining operation did not commence at that juncture; as a result of which tax could not have been saddled on the petitioner.
The Tax payer was also issued Reminder and was also given opportunity for personal hearing but the Tax payer has neither replied to the SCN nor appeared for personal hearing.

defects_argued.quote: Ergo, the order dated 26th December, 2025 and 6th January, 2026 cannot be held to be tenable in the eye of law for want of affording an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner and non- consideration of reply to show cause notice.

Ergo, the order dated 26th December, 2025 and 6th January, 2026 cannot be held to be tenable in the eye of law for want of affording an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner and non- consideration of reply to show cause notice.
The points raised by way of reply to show cause notice does not find place in the order impugned; as such the orders of the adjudicating authority smacks arbitrariness.

outcome.quote: In the result, the writ petition stands disposed of with the above observation and direction.
